description: This file provides HTTP utility functions and classes for making various HTTP requests, including GET, POST, DELETE, and file uploads, with support for retries, error handling, debugging, and multipart form data handling within a client library context.

classes.name: HTTPHelper
classes.description: A helper class encapsulating an HTTP client and related configurations for making requests, including request creation, dumping, and response handling.

classes.name: HTTPRequestBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing and executing HTTP requests with optional retries and JSON decoding.

classes.name: FilesUploader
classes.description: A class managing batch upload of files, handling chunking, multiple worker goroutines, and error collection.

classes.name: uploadChunkJob
classes.description: A data structure representing a specific chunk of a file to be uploaded, including file name, chunk number, total chunks, and size.

classes.name: uploadChunkWorker
classes.description: A worker class that processes upload jobs, manages retries with exponential backoff, and performs multipart uploads.

methods.name: NewGetRequest
methods.description: Constructs a new GET request for a specified path.

methods.name: NewDeleteRequest
methods.description: Constructs a new DELETE request for a specified path.

methods.name: NewPostRequest
methods.description: Constructs a new POST request with a JSON body.

methods.name: NewUploadFileRequest
methods.description: Constructs a new PUT request for uploading a file with specified content type.

methods.name: dumpRequest
methods.description: Dumps the HTTP request for debugging purposes.

methods.name: dumpResponse
methods.description: Dumps the HTTP response for debugging purposes.

methods.name: AddHeader
methods.description: Adds a header to the HTTP request.

methods.name: SetHeader
methods.description: Sets a header on the HTTP request.

methods.name: SetBasicAuth
methods.description: Sets basic authentication on the HTTP request.

methods.name: JSONResDo
methods.description: Executes the request and decodes JSON response into the provided interface, without retries.

methods.name: JSONResDoWithRetries
methods.description: Executes the request with retries and decodes JSON response.

methods.name: setAuthz
methods.description: Sets authorization headers based on access token or basic auth.

methods.name: doWithRetries
methods.description: Executes the request with retries, handling specific status codes.

methods.name: isIn
methods.description: Checks if a status code is within a list of status codes.

methods.name: getFilesInfos
methods.description: Gets size info for files to be uploaded and calculates total chunks.

methods.name: sendJobs
methods.description: Dispatches upload jobs for each file chunk.

methods.name: startWorkers
methods.description: Starts worker goroutines for handling upload jobs.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins processing an upload chunk job, with exponential backoff retries.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Performs the upload of a specific file chunk via multipart request.
